verdict: Memory supercycle confirmed: MU FY2026 Q4 blowout + FY2027 guide $60-63B; AVGO leading $50B OpenAI Nexus deal is a fresh ASIC-shift catalyst; DRAM pricing accelerating into Q4.
body_md:
## Fresh Developments (last 24-72h)

**DRAM/Memory (Signals 1 & 2)**
- TrendForce (Sep 30): Q4-2026 conventional DRAM +10-15% QoQ; PC DRAM +13-18% QoQ. Supply tight, CSP demand robust. HBM3E 2026 contract prices ~+20% vs prior-year agreements.
- **Micron FY2026 Q4** (Sep 30 print, market digesting now): Revenue $54.23B vs $51.13B est; EPS $33.42 vs $31.50 est. **FY2027 guide raised to $60-63B** (vs prior $49-51B). CEO: "even stronger fiscal 2027." Memory supercycle thesis validated.
- SK Hynix CFO: 2026 HBM fully sold out. Micron targeting 100K HBM wafers/month by year-end (from ~45-50K). Qualification timelines -- not wafer capacity -- remain the binding HBM4 constraint.

**Hyperscaler Capex (Signal 3)**
- 2026 combined now tracking $700-745B (above $600-700B baseline). Meta raised to $125-145B; Alphabet to $180-190B; Amazon held ~$200B. No first guide-down observed.
- **AVGO/OpenAI (Oct 9, fresh):** Broadcom leading a **$50B debt financing** round for OpenAI's "Nexus" custom AI chip buildout -- direct near-term revenue catalyst for AVGO; structural ASIC-shift risk building for NVDA.

**AMD / Custom ASICs (Signal 4)**
- AMD Helios rack + MI400 in full production; ships end-Q3, ramping into 2027. 72x MI455X per rack, 31TB HBM4, 2.9 exaflops FP4 (NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 still leads at 3.6 exaflops).
- Google reportedly tapping AMD to co-design next-gen TPU (SemiAnalysis, Aug 2026) -- unconfirmed.

**Optical (Signal 5):** No fresh October news. Coherent CPO scale-out revenue on track for 2H-2026 per prior guidance; NVIDIA Spectrum-6 CPO listed as 2H-2026 announced/sampling. No InP lead-time updates.

**Solar (Signal 6)**
- Section 232 price floor ($0.38/W, ~+40% vs Q1 spot) effective **Dec 4, 2026**. AD/CVD vote on India/Indonesia/Laos modules scheduled **Oct 14** -- near-term catalyst watch for FSLR (domestic manufacturer, benefits vs importers).

---

## Watchlist Movers

| Name | Move | Catalyst |
|------|------|----------|
| **MU** | Sep 30 print digesting | FY-Q4 blowout; FY27 guide $60-63B vs prior $49-51B |
| **AVGO** | ~$361.54 | Leading $50B OpenAI Nexus chip debt financing (Oct 9) |
| **ALAB** | Prior session ~-12% | Q2 beat ($392M rev, +104% YoY) below inflated expectations; Needham $425 Buy, TD Cowen cut to $375 Hold |
| **MRVL** | ~$275.28, near 52-wk high | $20B FY28 target reiterated; $70-90B FY31 long-range |
| **NVDA** | ~$229.28, -0.52% | Early talks with Reflection AI; no major move |
| **CRDO** | No fresh move | Q rev +157% to $437M; FY26 ~$2.4B; ~40x fwd earnings (cheap vs ALAB at 115x) |

No notable movers: SNDK, WDC, STX, RMBS, MRAM, LITE, CIEN, FSLR, ENPH, NXT, ARRY, HIVE, NOW, ZS, CRM, SNOW, TSLA, GDDY, NOK, AMPX, ALMU.

---

## Context vs Baseline

- **HBM correction risk unresolved** but timeline intact: all three suppliers completing capacity expansions late 2026 on schedule. No new SK Hynix comment on "correction after 2026."
- Capex now $700-745B (above $600-700B baseline) -- bullish HBM/NVDA ecosystem, but OpenAI Nexus/AVGO deal confirms ASIC diversification is accelerating.
- HIVE: GPU Cloud ARR pipeline ~$155M, targeting $200M by Q4-2026. No October catalyst.

---

## Signals Flashing

| Signal | Direction | Bull/Bear |
|--------|-----------|-----------|
| DRAM/HBM pricing | Accelerating (+10-15% QoQ Q4) | **Bull** |
| HBM4 ramp | On track; qualification = binding constraint | Neutral |
| Hyperscaler capex | Above baseline ($700-745B) | **Bull** |
| Custom ASIC shift | Accelerating (AMD live; OpenAI Nexus) | Bear NVDA / Bull AVGO |
| Optical CPO | No fresh catalyst; scale-out 2H-26 on track | Neutral |
| Solar tariffs | Dec 4 floor + Oct 14 AD/CVD vote | Bull FSLR |
| HBM correction risk (post-2026) | Capacity on schedule, risk building | Watch |

---

## Most Important Development

**Micron FY2026 Q4 blowout + FY2027 guide of $60-63B** is the week's single most consequential data point: it confirms the memory supercycle is not just intact but accelerating into 2027, pulling the bull case forward. Secondary: **AVGO leading $50B OpenAI Nexus financing** (Oct 9) signals hyperscaler custom silicon is now a multi-billion dollar near-term revenue story for AVGO -- and a structural long-range risk for NVDA GPU market share.

---
